claim: `namingOver` in `check-reaches-a-path-through-the-index` draws the page-file name tails it judges by from `shadow.listed()`, and the tree search folds into that every ignored path whose name holds `.uncommitted.`. A tail a tmux attach wrote minutes ago is in the set, and another agent on the same commit may not hold it, so the LISTED verdict at change depends on transient state rather than on the commit. Two agents on one commit can disagree, and nothing afterwards says which of them read what. This was masked while the tails came from the listing index. A tail is not a fact about which files are there: `.module.code.ts` and `.seat.uncommitted.attachment.json` are what page types declare, through their file properties and file-property groups. Built downward from the pages the set is a function of the commit alone.

evidence:
Measured 2026-09-14 against HEAD as it moved through `90667a3ffc4` and `e3d626f8481`, over the 51,180 files this check judges.

THE TAIL SETS, COUNTED. `tailsOf` at line 66 of the check's decision takes a tail off each path whose name carries a page type between its dots. Counted over four sources on one checkout: the listing index, 855; the pages alone, drawn from the identity index, 416; `shadow.listed()`, 860; `everythingIn(root).changed`, 845. `90667a3ffc4` handed `namingOver` the pages and lost 439 of 855, `module.code.ts`, `module.test.ts` and `computed-property.code.ts` among them. `e3d626f8481` put the vocabulary back, which is what leaves the set resting on the checkout.

WHERE THE TRANSIENT TAILS COME FROM. The tree search runs twice and takes, from the run that reads ignored paths, every path whose name holds `.uncommitted.`. `shadow.listed()` therefore carried five tails no commit holds — `model-test.entries.uncommitted.jsonl`, `model-test.positives.uncommitted.jsonl`, `code-editor-terminal.ended.uncommitted.attachment.json`, `code-editor-terminal.seat.uncommitted.attachment.json` and `seat.uncommitted.attachment.json` — and lacked one the index had, `seat.refusals.uncommitted.txt`. The two sides of the check disagree in both directions: the audit's own file listing keeps an ignored path only where `uncommittedHeld` says so, so it lacks eleven `entries.uncommitted.jsonl` and `logs.uncommitted.jsonl` tails the listing index had, and gains the two `model-test` ones.

WHAT THE SEAM HAS PRODUCED. One refusal, at change and not at audit. Line 11 of the terminal seat marks module spells `.code-editor-terminal.seat.uncommitted.attachment.json`, and `marksIn` at line 111 lists a directory, so LISTED fires. That tail is in the set only because a tmux attach left a mark on disk. The module writes those marks from a shell function keyed by pid and process start time and reads them back by listing, and the index answers for none of them. It is judged a false positive and left as it is, evidence rather than an exemption: this check's page carries no exemption list, and exemptions elsewhere are page properties on the file exempted.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED. No disagreement between two agents has been seen, only the mechanism that would make one. The 860 and the 845 are one checkout at one moment, and another checkout gives other numbers, which is the finding rather than a caveat on it. Whether every one of the 855 is reachable from what page types declare was not checked one by one.
